compact.$description: Spacing scale multiplier for compact density (desktop default).

standard.$description: Spacing scale multiplier for standard density (tablet default).

comfortable.$description: Spacing scale multiplier for comfortable density (mobile default).

active.$description: Currently active spacing scale multiplier. dist/css/density.css re-points it per breakpoint or [data-density].

compact.$description: Minimum interactive control block size at compact density (=36px at 16px root).

standard.$description: Minimum interactive control block size at standard density (=40px at 16px root).

comfortable.$description: Minimum interactive control block size at comfortable density (=44px at 16px root); meets the touch target floor.

active.$description: Currently active minimum control size. dist/css/density.css re-points it per breakpoint or [data-density].

min.$description: Minimum touch target size (vision §7.1: 44px; expressed as 2.75rem so it scales with the root font size).
